basic_info.description: Welcome to one of the best view homes in beautiful San Francisco!  Located in one of the City's classic doorman buildings, Fontana West, enjoy views of the Bay, Alcatraz and Golden Gate Bridge day and night.  Walk to Aquatic Park, Ghirardelli Square, Fort Mason, the Marina Green, Polk Street, Chestnut Street, North Beach, Telegraph Hill and the Embarcadero easily.  Major transit lines are a block away as is the new dog-friendly Francisco Park.  Fourth of July and Fleet Week are amazing from here.  HOA dues are low at $747.88 and include 24 hour front door staff, controlled elevator access, water, electricity, garbage, maintenance reserve,  24 hour garage with guest parking, outdoor heated pool, BBQ and lounge area, community room, car wash area and zen garden. Some of the finest bars and restaurants in San Francisco are nearby.
